title: Drugs, Chemistry & Pharmacovigilance
blurb: Adverse-event reports, drug labels, drug–target and side-effect knowledge bases, and prescribing data.

items.name: openFDA
items.description: Public APIs and bulk downloads for FDA data: adverse event reports (drugs, devices, food), recalls, drug labels and NDC directory.
items.access_note: Open API (free key for higher rate limits) and bulk files.

items.name: FAERS
items.description: Quarterly raw files of spontaneous adverse-event and medication-error reports submitted to FDA since 2004 — the main source for disproportionality analyses.
items.access_note: Direct download (quarterly ASCII/XML) and public dashboard.

items.name: VAERS
items.description: US national early-warning system collecting reports of adverse events after vaccination, with downloadable raw data since 1990.
items.access_note: Direct download and CDC WONDER queries.

items.name: EudraVigilance (adrreports.eu)
items.description: Public access to aggregated suspected adverse-reaction reports for medicines authorised in the European Economic Area.
items.access_note: Open web reports; line listings on request.

items.name: VigiAccess
items.description: Public window into VigiBase, the WHO global database of 35 million+ individual case safety reports from 150+ countries.
items.access_note: Open summary search; full VigiBase extracts require application and may carry fees.

items.name: nSIDES (OFFSIDES & TWOSIDES)
items.description: Data-mined drug side-effect (OFFSIDES) and drug–drug interaction (TWOSIDES) signals derived from FAERS with confounding correction.

paper.label: Tatonetti NP et al. Sci Transl Med 2012;4:125ra31

items.name: SIDER
items.description: Side effects and indications of marketed medicines extracted from drug package inserts and mapped to MedDRA.

paper.label: Kuhn M et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2016;44:D1075

items.name: DrugBank Online
items.description: Comprehensive drug knowledge base: chemistry, targets, pharmacology, interactions and pathways for ~16,000 drugs.
items.access_note: Web browsing open; full XML download free for academic use with an approved account. Commercial use licensed.

paper.label: Knox C et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2024;52:D1265

items.name: ChEMBL
items.description: Manually curated database of bioactive drug-like molecules with >20 million bioactivity measurements against targets.

paper.label: Zdrazil B et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2024;52:D1180

items.name: PubChem
items.description: The world's largest free chemistry database: compounds, substances, bioassays, patents and safety information.
items.access_note: Open web, FTP and PUG-REST API.

paper.label: Kim S et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2023;51:D1373

items.name: DailyMed
items.description: Official FDA-approved structured product labels (package inserts) for prescription and OTC drugs, downloadable in SPL XML.
items.access_note: Open web, API and bulk download.

items.name: RxNorm
items.description: Normalised names and identifiers for clinical drugs linking many drug vocabularies, with the free RxNav APIs.
items.access_note: Full files need a free UMLS licence; RxNav APIs are open.

items.name: WHO ATC/DDD Index
items.description: The Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification and Defined Daily Doses used worldwide for drug-utilisation research.
items.provider: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology
items.access_note: Open web index (machine-readable files sold separately).
